statements.text: Assessment: left lumbar radiculopathy at L4-L5 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
CT lumbar spine 08/17/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline NRS prior to any intervention: 7/10.
Reports low back pain radiating to the left leg for 7 weeks.
Remains engaged in a home exercise program five days a week.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
Epidural steroid injection history: 1 lumbar injection in the past 12 months (11/28/2025).
